test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 11 Nov 2021 Shift 1
subject: general
question:
**Select the correct active form of the given sentence. **

Hundreds of villages in West Bengal have been devastated by Cyclone Amphan.

options.text: Cyclone Amphan has devastated hundreds of villages in West Bengal.
Cyclone Amphan is devastating hundreds of villages in West Bengal.
Cyclone Amphan has been devastating hundreds of villages in West Bengal.
Cyclone Amphan was devastating hundreds of villages in West Bengal.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Cyclone Amphan has devastated hundreds of villages in West Bengal.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the passive form and in the **Present Perfect Simple** tense.
 
• The Present Perfect Simple in the passive voice has the following form: **Object + have/has + been + verb3 (past participle) + Subject**__
 
• The Present Perfect Simple in the active voice has the following form: __**Subject + has/have + past participle form of the verb + object**__
 __
 
• Passive: *Football has been played by them.*
 
• Active: *They have played football*.
 
 
 
• In the active voice of the Present Perfect Simple, we have to change the structure, so the subject in the passive voice becomes the object in the active voice.
 
• ​Therefore, the correct answer is option 1.

 

Correct Active Voice:__ *Cyclone Amphan has devastated hundreds of villages in West Bengal.*
